title: The Hodge -3mi to Downtown
description:
Escape the ordinary as you step into our funky boho Airbnb! Fill a unique vintage glass with your drink of choice and allow the vibrant colors and cozy design to welcome you into vacay mode! 

The Hodge is located 3 miles from downtown Nashville, and a walkable distance from Geodis Park, coffee shops and restaurants! 

With 2 bedrooms and 5 beds, this house is the perfect fit for small groups who want to enjoy their downtime as much as their reason for visiting the famous Music City.
